title: A Horizon for the Gravity Again
author: Wendell Reyes
blurb: Oscar Underhill, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the fleet's truce expires.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
